text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much, Bouquet-san...! To 
even receive a birthday present from 
you...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"You're welcome. On your special day, 
Chrono, I just wanted you to have an 
enriching time, even if only a little."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so humbled... Bouquet-san is always 
so considerate of me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
I tried to choose a present that you might 
like, Chrono-san... I hope it suits your 
taste.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: In a book I found at a secondhand bookstore called Compendium of Historical Racing Documents: Modern Era—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
A-Amazing...! This is a masterpiece that's 
completely out of print...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
My. Is that so...? I just happened to find 
it by chance, though...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It contains primary sources from before 
racing regulations took their modern form. 
There are so many precious accounts from 
that era...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Besides... it should also have plenty of 
records and photos of the training 
sessions and equipment from back then... 
And then—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I-I'm so sorry. I was completely in 
my own world...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Not at all. Seeing you this 
happy... is the greatest reward of all.
